presentation.label: CORRUPT
presentation.summary: A Data Corrupter-style square synth: the note you play, a tracked sub and a divided harmony.
presentation.overview: A Data Corrupter-style square synth: the note you play, a tracked sub and a divided harmony.
highlights: Play single notes across the range and listen for the square-wave tracking.
usage: Add Corrupt from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Play single notes across the range and listen for the square-wave tracking.
Use the page buttons to reach the remaining controls.

access.location: Delay group in the MS-70CDR effect list, under Corrupt.
steps: Add Corrupt from the Delay group to a spare patch.

controls.name: Wave
controls.doc: params[7]. Octave-up harmony square level (richness). Range 0–100.

controls.name: Mix
controls.doc: Mix default 1 (quiet-safe). The editor materialises patches on load (full-patch send), so audible-on-load no longer needs a hot default. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.

load.conditions: The effect descriptor declares this cost. Audio load on the pedal is unmeasured.

tests.summary: Ziddle passed the loader check and rendered 22,050 stereo frames. The compiled file passed the stock-code scan and MS-70CDR size limits. Hardware untested.
